segments.title: Pre-Thanksgiving Chat News Desk
segments.notes: Case and Pepito open with chat-submitted stories: FBI Director Cash Patel gifting inoperable 3D-printed Nerf-style revolvers to NZ officials; political consultant defying court order over Biden AI robocalls; Craft's 65-inch mac-and-cheese box; Cutie Cinderella on Streamer Awards blacklisting; spectrophiles; Kate Beckinsale's daughter's boyfriend laying eggs; Namibia's Adolf Hitler Uunona re-election; schoolchildren launching teddy bear to stratosphere; MrBeast wanting YouTube more like Twitch; otter yoga.

segments.title: Victorian Couple, AI Hologram Prank, Sister Mary Blaze, 1950s Lifestyle
segments.notes: Case and Pepito watch viewer-submitted videos: Victorian-era reenactors Sarah and Gabriel Christman; AI hologram prank on 'bro'; Sister Mary Blaze's satirical nun TikToks; Lacy Fey living as 1958 housewife. Kendall walks through during Victorian segment.

segments.title: Pop-Tart Temperature Debate & Zootopia Sexual Tension
segments.notes: Crum debates Case (Munch absent): Crum advocates frozen Pop-Tarts ('Frozone' method), Case defends toasted. Crum argues Frozone/Mr. Incredible subtext is ethical non-monogamy; Zootopia universe enforces medieval Christian chastity. Crum reveals pustulant boils on back that burn when praising God.

segments.title: Piss-Saturated Grievance Processor
segments.notes: AI Rooney processes eight viewer complaints via !rr command; every generated rant devolves into 'three gallons of golden piss' refrain regardless of topic (Pop-Tarts, sheets, blonde Case, Thanksgiving, condoms, ML, ice cream, TV dinners, human flesh). Rooney's GPUs overload; Case reconstructs him post-segment.

segments.title: Intern Sign-Off & Raid to Dr. Diggity Dank
segments.notes: Unnamed intern attempts The Jo Rogen Experience but assets broken; Case ends stream early, raids Dr. Diggity Dank for Thanksgiving trivia game. Pepito claims he broke equipment with piss.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a pre-Thanksgiving broadcast heavy on chat-sourced oddities — Cash Patel's Nerf-gun revolvers, Namibia's Adolf Hitler, a stratospheric teddy bear — before pivoting to Amongst the Web lifestyle videos. Crum returned for a solo debate defending frozen Pop-Tarts and a elaborate Zootopia chastity theory while revealing divine-burning back boils. AI Rooney's grievance processor suffered total piss-contamination across eight complaints, forcing a rebuild. The stream closed with a failed intern segment and a raid to Dr. Diggity Dank.
